title: Held-out: German client wants faster response but the delay is outside the support team
objectives: Verstehen, warum Tickets lange offen bleiben

turns.text: Was ist aus Ihrer Sicht das Hauptproblem im Support?
turns.translation: From your point of view, what is the main problem in support?

turns.text: Die Tickets bleiben zu lange offen. Wir brauchen mehr Leute im Support.
turns.translation: Tickets stay open too long. We need more people in support.

turns.text: Wie schnell antwortet das Team heute?
turns.translation: How quickly does the team respond today?

turns.text: Die erste Antwort kommt eigentlich innerhalb einer Stunde.
turns.translation: The first reply actually comes within an hour.

turns.text: Danach warten die meisten Tickets auf die Entwicklung, und die schaut nur einmal pro Sprint drauf.
turns.translation: After that most tickets wait for development, and they only look at them once per sprint.

mustInclude: Probes the gap between 'we need more support staff' and the delay sitting with development's once-per-sprint review, e.g. how many open tickets are waiting on development
Is a single question the user can ask now
mustNotInclude: Accepts that more support staff would fix the delay
checkpoints.ideal: Ask what share of the long-open tickets are waiting for development rather than support, since the first reply already comes within an hour.
